description:
GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/calibration response: one stored calibration snapshot of
an IBM Quantum device or an Amazon Braket QPU. vendor_updated_at is when the vendor
published the calibration, captured_at is when the router stored it.

calibration.description: The vendor's calibration object exactly as published. For IBM Quantum these are the backend properties (backend_name, backend_version, last_update_date, qubits, gates, general), with every time as an RFC 3339 string. For an Amazon Braket QPU it is the device capabilities object as Braket publishes it (braketSchemaHeader, service, action, deviceParameters, paradigm, provider, standardized, and pulse on some devices), the same object the Braket SDK exposes as device properties.
calibration.title: Calibration
